extracted.name: Mushroom brioche soldiers
extracted.description: Transform breakfast classic egg and soldiers with lashings of mushroom pâté and a sprinkling of tarragon on strips of brioche - the perfect partner to a runny yolk
instruction_lines: Bring a small pan of water to the boil. Add the egg and cook for 5 mins. Toast the brioche, then mix the mushroom pâté and tarragon, if you like. Spread over the toasted brioche, cut into soldiers and dip.
